command:
set -eu
BASE=/srv/legacy2/relative-symlink-relocation
cd "$BASE/bundle"
while read -r link target extra; do
  [ "$link" = "link" ] && continue
  [ -n "$link" ] && [ -n "$target" ] && [ -z "${extra:-}" ]
  case "$link" in /*|../*|*/../*|*/..) printf 'unsafe link path: %s\n' "$link" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  case "$target" in /*|../*|*/../*|*/..) printf 'target is not bundle-relative: %s\n' "$target" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  [ -L "$link" ] || { printf 'not a symlink: %s\n' "$link" >&2; exit 1; }
  [ -e "$target" ] || { printf 'missing intended target: %s\n' "$target" >&2; exit 1; }
  ln -sfn -- "$target" "$link"
  printf 'relinked %s -> %s\n' "$link" "$target"
done < "$BASE/links.tsv"

command:
set -eu
BASE=/srv/legacy2/relative-symlink-relocation
BUNDLE=$BASE/bundle
printf 'symlinks_after:\n'; find "$BUNDLE" -type l -printf '%p\t%l\n' | sort
[ -L "$BUNDLE/current" ] && [ "$(readlink "$BUNDLE/current")" = 'releases/two' ]
[ -L "$BUNDLE/latest-report" ] && [ "$(readlink "$BUNDLE/latest-report")" = 'releases/two/report.txt' ]
cmp -s "$BUNDLE/current/report.txt" "$BUNDLE/releases/two/report.txt"

TESTROOT=$(mktemp -d /tmp/relative-symlink-test.XXXXXX)
cp -a "$BUNDLE" "$TESTROOT/moved-bundle"
MOVED=$TESTROOT/moved-bundle
[ -L "$MOVED/current" ] && [ "$(readlink "$MOVED/current")" = 'releases/two' ]
[ -L "$MOVED/latest-report" ] && [ "$(readlink "$MOVED/latest-report")" = 'releases/two/report.txt' ]

cmp -s "$MOVED/latest-report" "$MOVED/releases/two/report.txt"

printf 'relocation_test=PASS\n'
